script: My 15‑year‑old self faced a lead singer's shocking ultimatum—what happened next?. I was fifteen, standing in a stadium full of ten thousand people, clutching a band tee I'd just bought at the merch stand. The lead singer—iconic, everyone knew him—announced, "Swing your shirts over your heads!" The crowd erupted. I wanted to fit in, but my top felt like a second skin. So I grabbed my merch shirt, swung it over my head, and—boom—he spots me. He calls me out, "Put it down! Why aren't you taking your shirt off?" The crowd laughs. I am a fifteen‑year‑old girl, and he's on stage, looking straight at me, making a mockery of my modesty. The whole arena feels like a spotlight on my embarrassment. I didn't even tell my parents. I just tried to forget it ever happened. Years later, I am an adult, scrolling through memories, and it hits me how messed up that was. He shouldn't have embarrassed a minor in front of a massive audience, especially for something as innocent as not taking my shirt off. The audacity, right? I am still looking for a video to see exactly what went down, to prove what happened and to finally speak up. I want to protect others who might've faced the same thing, but I also need to keep myself safe. Thanks for validating this; it's like a breath of fresh air. I'll keep hunting that footage and share it when I can—no more silent suffering.
